script.text: Good morning! I'm Kelly, and this is your daily lesson for November 13. Today we're exploring two powerful ideas together.
Something feels wrong.  You can't explain it, but you feel uneasy.  That's your alarm system—millions of years of evolution detecting patterns your conscious mind hasn't noticed.

Your brain processes millions of signals you never consciously notice. When patterns suggest danger, you feel uneasy before knowing why. The alarm fires before the analysis completes. Trust instinct in its domain: detecting social threats, sensing environmental danger, recognizing patterns in familiar territory.  Be more skeptical when instinct encounters unfamiliar situations.
Today's wisdom: Here's today's wisdom: Your body knows things your mind hasn't noticed.  Intuition is data processed below consciousness.
Now let's take what we learned and put it into practice.
Today's growth challenge is Intuition Log - What Is Your Body Telling You?.

Here's your activity: Recall times your intuition was right. What did it feel like? Now notice current intuitive signals. What feels 'off' that you can't explain? Don't dismiss it—investigate it. This helps you recognize and evaluate intuitive signals.
And here's how today's lessons connect: What you learned about your body's alarm system can be applied to intuition log - what is your body telling you?. Practice makes progress.
That's today's lesson. Learn something, grow a little. I'll see you tomorrow with something new. Stay curious!
